description: This PHP source file defines the LoggerManager class, which manages different log levels, loggers, and logging behaviors within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for logging at various levels, configuring loggers, and managing log levels and mappings.

classes.name: LoggerManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages logging levels, loggers, and logging operations for the application.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles logging requests dynamically based on method name, determining log level and forwarding messages to appropriate loggers.

methods.name: wouldLog
methods.description: Checks if a log message at a specified level would be logged based on current log level settings.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Performs a debug log if a specified condition evaluates to false, used for assertions.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the current logging level by name.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LoggerManager.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a specific logger class to a particular log level.

methods.name: _findAvailableLoggers
methods.description: Discovers available logger classes in predefined directories.

methods.name: getAvailableLoggers
methods.description: Returns the list of available logger class names.

methods.name: getLoggerLevels
methods.description: Provides a list of log levels mapped with human-readable labels.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the current log level globally.

methods.name: setLevelMapping
methods.description: Configures the numeric value associated with a specific log level.
